005/**
006 * Called when tooltip info about how far a location is/how much fuel/time it takes to get there is created.
007 * At the moment, this happens in two places:
008 *      The star icon tooltip (on the hyperspace map)
009 *      Intel icons
010 *      
011 */
012public interface NavigationDataSectionListener {
013        public void reportNavigationDataSectionAboutToBeCreated(SectorEntityToken target); 
014        public void reportNavigationDataSectionWasCreated(SectorEntityToken target); 
015}
